hooks.prompt:
Review the code changes made for this task to ensure i18n compliance.

Rules:
1. All user-facing UI text (button labels, form labels, headings, placeholders, error messages, success messages, tooltips, aria-labels, status text) in frontend .tsx/.ts files MUST use translation keys via the `t()` function from react-i18next, NOT hardcoded strings.
2. All user-facing error messages and validation messages in backend route/service files MUST use `req.t()` or `i18n.t()` translation keys, NOT hardcoded strings.
3. Email subjects and body text in backend services MUST use i18n translation keys.
4. EXCEPTIONS (do NOT flag these): LLM system prompts, AI model context, Build123d API references, tool_use descriptions, any content in files under services that is sent to LLM providers, log messages (logger.info/debug/warn/error), internal comments, TypeScript type definitions, CSS class names, route paths, environment variable names.
5. New translation keys used in code MUST exist in both en/ and de/ locale JSON files.
6. Check that the validate:translations script passes if translation files were modified.

If any violations are found, return {"ok": false, "reason": "description of violations with file paths and line numbers"}.
If all checks pass, return {"ok": true}.
